data.taskBrief:
TASK BRIEF: Create a Jira issue from a Slack thread, including a description and link to the original Slack message (Jira)

FIT
  Fully. The supplied request creates the Jira ticket and includes the Slack message URL in its description.

AUTH
  Basic authentication
  Supply the Jira username and API token as the Basic Auth username and password, respectively. The request references them as `{{jira_username}}` and `{{jira_api_token}}`; no collection values for these placeholders are provided.

BASE URL
  https://postmanlabs.atlassian.net

STEPS
  1. POST /rest/api/3/issue
     Params (JSON body):
       fields.project.id: string — `'10000'` — project ID in the body; replace with the target Jira project ID.
       fields.issuetype.name: string — `'Task'` — issue type name in the body.
       fields.summary: string — `'Investigate Slack request'` — issue title in the body.
       fields.description.content[0].content[0].text: string — `'Details from the Slack thread'` — issue description text in the body.
       fields.description.content[0].content[1].attrs.href: string — `'https://slack.com/archives/example/p1660000000000000'` — original Slack message URL used as the link target in the body.
       fields.description.content[0].content[1].text: string — `'Original Slack Message'` — visible link text in the body.
     Returns:
       No saved response example is provided. A successful call is expected to create the Jira issue, but the response fields and status code are not specified by the supplied schema.
     Threading:
       None

GOTCHAS
  - The body is structured as Jira REST API v3 document-format JSON; preserve the nested `fields.description` document, including `type` and `version` values.
  - The request has no explicit `Content-Type` header; send the raw body as JSON and verify that the client sets `application/json`.
  - Replace `{{jira_username}}`, `{{jira_api_token}}`, `{{project_id}}`, `{{issueType}}`, `{{summary}}`, `{{description}}`, and `{{slack_url}}` with actual values. The collection context supplies no variable values.
  - `project.id` requires a Jira project ID, while `issuetype.name` requires an issue type name; do not substitute one for the other.
